purpose: Daemon-free native AOT worker with exact JSON/source interoperability, plus explicit legacy HTTP compatibility; generated engine binaries and dictionaries are not committed
default_backend: private managed native worker over stdin/stdout

native_api.other_desktop_platforms: macOS and Windows source support; native builds not qualified

native_source_mapping.evidence: Retained CSynWord graphematical offsets, an original graphan snapshot, pinned one-single-byte-per-Unicode-scalar conversion, exact source substrings and whitespace-only gaps
native_source_mapping.normalized_infinitive: Require original ZU/infinitive tokens and the explicit gZuVerbForm reading; retain separate original spans when the serializer keeps the ZU token
native_source_mapping.uncertain_mapping: Stop adding metadata at the uncertain token; never invent a source position
